## Drips Wave Task Specification

**Wave Program**: [Drips Wave](https://www.drips.network/wave) — Stellar Ecosystem Sprint  
**Target Repository**: `StellarClear/stellarclear-app`  
**Complexity / Points**: <!-- e.g., 100 points (Trivial/Low) | 150 points (Medium) | 200 points (High) -->

### 1. Context & Objective
Briefly describe the task, the module affected (`services/api`, `services/indexer`, `services/matcher`, `packages/sdk`, `packages/proof`, `docs-site`), and how this improves StellarClear.

### 2. Technical Scope
- [ ] Detail the functions, types, schemas, or UI components to update
- [ ] Specify error handling, validations, or tests required

### 3. Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] All workspaces compile cleanly (`npm run build`)
- [ ] TypeScript typecheck passes with zero errors (`npm run typecheck`)
- [ ] Test suites pass cleanly (`npm test`)
- [ ] Full release verification passes (`npm run verify:release`)
- [ ] Conventional Commit format used in PR title and commits (`feat(...)`, `fix(...)`, etc.)

### 4. Contributor Guidance
1. Ensure your identity / KYC is verified on [Drips Wave](https://www.drips.network/wave).
2. Claim this task via the Drips Wave web application.
3. Link your PR to this issue using `Fixes #<issue-number>`.
